summary: We are looking for a skilled Website Developer with strong experience in Shopify and WordPress to join our team. The ideal candidate should be able to build, customize, and optimize websites, especially for e-commerce projects.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain websites on Shopify and WordPress (including WooCommerce).
Customize Shopify themes, Liquid templates, and third-party apps.
Customize WordPress themes, plugins, and page builders (Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, etc.).
Implement responsive, mobile-friendly designs and ensure cross-browser compatibility.
Optimize website performance, loading speed, and SEO structure.
Integrate third-party tools, payment gateways, APIs, and marketing apps.
Manage website updates, backups, security, and troubleshooting.
Collaborate with designers, content teams, and marketing teams for project execution.
Test and debug websites before deployment.
required_skills: Proven experience in Shopify development (themes, Liquid, apps, store setup).
Strong understanding of WordPress development (themes, plugins, builders).
Knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, and basic PHP.
Experience in Shopify apps and WordPress plugins.
Understanding of SEO best practices and website optimization.
nice_to_have_skills: Experience with Shopify Plus or advanced WooCommerce customization.
Knowledge of Figma/Adobe XD for converting designs to websites.
Basic understanding of graphic design is a plus.
